evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Five LLMs generate solutions to MBPP, HumanEval, and DS-1000, seven more to MBPP, and models act as evaluators in four tasks: picking their own solution from a pair, judging whether a single solution is their own, identifying which of two solutions a named model wrote, and judging quality blind.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: In the single-solution task, balanced accuracy is 49-58% for all 15 model-benchmark combinations, while raw accuracy (38-67%) mostly reflects how readily a model claims authorship.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We recommend reporting balanced accuracy, heuristic baselines, and label consistency.
